title: Design System: Beyond the Ordinary — MIBC Recruitment

display-studio.purpose: Heavy Space Grotesk campaign hero with serif emphasis.

headline.purpose: Default section heading; each world overrides where implemented.

body.purpose: Root prose foundation; reading passages use the implemented local size and measure.

shadows.name: studio-track-paper
shadows.purpose: Paper depth on Studio weekly track sheets.

motion.name: ease-response
motion.purpose: Shared transform response, image entrance, poster and prose reveal.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Link/button/summary color, background and press transforms; plus-stroke collapse.

motion.name: prose-reveal
motion.purpose: IntersectionObserver reveals each marked passage once; content is never pre-hidden.

motion.name: poster-response
motion.purpose: Edition poster hover darkening and tilt.

motion.name: poster-change
motion.purpose: Edition poster message entrance after activation.

motion.name: globe-drag
motion.purpose: Horizontal pointer movement; canvas touch-action is pan-y.

motion.name: globe-release
motion.value: stiffness 100; damping 20; max travel ±1.2 radians; dt ≤.032s; settle .002
motion.purpose: Bounded damped release response; canceled by a new drag. No idle rotation.

motion.name: scroll-scenes
motion.purpose: Native scroll controls visible scenes; updates settle and sleep until new input. Signal sculpture shifts vertically with rotating geometry and alternating manifesto text; Edition hinges its poster at the left edge; Studio rotates paper in opposing directions and reverses its horizontal ticker with scroll direction; Invitation rotates seal geometry and subtly scales its lettering.

motion.name: globe-scroll
motion.purpose: Visible globe rotation, changing tilt and a bright traveller along an inclined orbit follow native scroll, layered with direct drag yaw. No idle rotation.

motion.name: invitation-stamp
motion.purpose: The closing seal stamps into place once when it enters view; content remains visible without JavaScript.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Transitions/animations become .01ms; smooth scrolling becomes auto; knot, scroll-scene transforms, closing-seal stamp, prose reveals, poster tilt, globe scroll rotation and release inertia are skipped. Direct globe drag and arrow controls remain available.

motion.name: reduced-transparency
motion.purpose: Navigator uses its opaque ground and no backdrop blur.

motion.name: club-program-scenes
motion.purpose: Desktop native-scroll fanning for Signal/Studio tracks, perspective turns for Edition, vertical track shifts for Orbit, seasonal geometry rotation, and small alternating Studio event-title shifts. At widths up to 760px, PageMotion enables mobile-stack only when viewport height is at least 650px and every sheet is shorter than viewport height minus 150px: sticky offsets 20/40/60px, 24vh gaps, and preceding-sheet scale 1→.935 as the next sheet approaches, reversing with upward scroll. Edition and Orbit sheets are opaque; focus-within brings a sheet forward at full scale. Short viewports and taller content retain normal flow. Phone event headings translate from alternating 42/-32px offsets, rotate from ±5deg and scale .88→1; rule traces and asterisk travel follow arrival progress. Reduced motion and the default presentation remain static and visible.

narrative.overview:
The completed system presents MIBC through five distinct recruitment worlds. Burgundy, crimson, warm paper, fine geometric linework, and expressive typography connect them; their compositions and materials stay individual. The voice is curious, creative, ambitious, and welcoming. The title is original proposal copy, not an official event name.

Signal is a cinematic campaign with one sculptural image. Edition is an ivory student publication. Orbit is a dark interactive atlas. Studio is a coral creative canvas. Invitation is a burgundy invitation beside a warm paper letter. All share a readable club identity, clear application action, native scrolling, and restrained feedback. Apple Design and Impeccable inform the physical response, legibility, and finishing restraint already present in the code.
keyCharacteristics: Five distinct page worlds with shared foundations.
Large balanced headings, serif emphasis, generous margins, and fine rules.
Geometric linework, asterisks, simple arrows, and one crimson sculpture.
Direct application actions and native expandable answers.
Scroll-controlled and finite motion, local assets, and preference-aware presentation.
dos: **Do** retain each world’s matched palette, typography, composition, and button shape.
**Do** keep the club identity and application action clear in every world.
**Do** use fine rules, balanced headings, local fonts, and generous reading space as the common foundation.
**Do** preserve native details, visible keyboard focus, mobile stacking, and reduced-motion/transparency support.
**Do** keep motion scroll-controlled or finite and interaction-led, with ordinary content visible before JavaScript runs.
donts: **Don't** flatten the five worlds into a single burgundy template.
**Don't** replace the single abstract sculpture with unsupported member photography, testimonials, or invented identity assets.

**Don't** present the proposal title, unsupplied dates, eligibility, numeric club claims, or endorsements as official facts. Use the researched MIBC event names and evergreen summaries documented in docs/event-sources.md; do not restore outdoor descriptions or seasonal dates.
**Don't** add dependencies, autoplay media, or continuous background animation to reproduce the completed motion.
